purpose: Test whether delaying entry until a liquidity sweep is followed by an opposite market-structure shift and then the first unmitigated order-block retest improves the frozen 30-second entry economics.

public_logic_sources.source: MetaQuotes — Decoding Market Intent: Reading Structure, Liquidity, and Price Behavior
public_logic_sources.logic: A sweep is an ordered sequence: trade beyond a liquidity level, fail to continue, close back inside, then react away.

public_logic_sources.source: MetaQuotes — Optimizing Liquidity Raids: Difference Between Liquidity Raids and Market Structure Shifts
public_logic_sources.logic: A valid MSS requires a break of recent opposing structure with power; shifts after liquidity grabs are treated as higher-quality context.

public_logic_sources.source: MetaQuotes — Building an Object-Oriented Order Block Engine in MQL5
public_logic_sources.logic: Order block is the last opposite candle before displacement that closes through immediate structure; zone remains active until later mitigation/retest.
Community practice frequently waits for MSS after sweep, then uses an OB/FVG retest rather than entering on the sweep candle.

independence: Not a bare SFP or engulf-failure entry.
Not the 17E same-break-bar FVG continuation rule.
Requires three causal stages: sweep, opposite MSS, later OB retest.

common_semantics.swing: symmetric two-bar confirmed fractal swing; visible only after two completed right-side bars
common_semantics.bearish_sweep: completed bar high > active confirmed swing high AND close < that swing high
common_semantics.bullish_sweep: completed bar low < active confirmed swing low AND close > that swing low
common_semantics.mss: after sweep, first completed close beyond the latest confirmed opposite swing that was already visible at sweep time; bearish sweep requires close below opposite swing low, bullish mirror
common_semantics.order_block: last opposite-colour completed candle strictly after sweep and strictly before MSS bar; zone is candle body [min(open,close), max(open,close)]
common_semantics.invalidation: before first retest, completed close through the OB far edge against the new shift direction invalidates setup
common_semantics.first_retest: first later completed bar after MSS whose range intersects the active OB body zone; zone consumed on that first interaction whether or not a proposal is emitted
common_semantics.ambiguity: same completed bar cannot emit both directions; if it causally completes both, emit none
common_semantics.proposal_timing: first executable tick at/after completed retest-bar edge

R037-SMOR-C01_M1_BODY_TOUCH.retest: first range intersection with OB body; retest bar must close on shift-direction side of OB midpoint

R037-SMOR-C02_M1_MIDPOINT.retest: first bar reaching OB body midpoint; retest bar must close on shift-direction side of midpoint

R037-SMOR-C03_M5_BODY_TOUCH.retest: first range intersection with OB body; retest bar must close on shift-direction side of OB midpoint

R037-SMOR-C04_M5_MIDPOINT.retest: first bar reaching OB body midpoint; retest bar must close on shift-direction side of midpoint

screen_gate.winner_or_quality_gate: official-win delta nonnegative OR positive net with improved gross loss
